permissions.description: Extensible permission keys. macos_full_disk_access is the first key. Status is best effort; unknown means the platform could not determine access.

ui_package.description: The deployment's desktop UI package (package 0.1.47): whether the sidecar has installed the package the backend serves, is still checking, downloading or receiving it, or failed, and whether the calling client may relay it with sidecar.install_ui_package.v1. Null until a configure call delivered a valid ui_package in this sidecar process. Absent from sidecars that host no desktop UI and from sidecars built before 0.1.47.

state.description: current, pending or failed (section 11 of SPEC.md); clients treat an unknown value as pending.

reason.description: With failed: network, proxy, tls, unauthorized, not_found, verification, storage or other; clients treat an unknown value as other.
